services.title: Auto repair
services.body: Vehicles are diagnosed and repaired at the actual fault before anything gets replaced.

reviews.author: Garret Gay
reviews.text: Affordable auto repair and their crew are amazing. I received an affordable oil change and rotated my tires for me because the tread was low in the front. Tim, the owner, is the most honest and transparent mechanic you will meet with only looking out for what’s best for you. You’re in extremely capable hands here.

reviews.author: Loretta “OnePupil9” Crosby
reviews.text: After three months of chasing down an engine light for my DMV inspection, going through 4 to 5 different mechanics with no real answers, I was honestly at my wits' end. With another deadline approaching, I took my car to Affordable Auto Repair as a last resort before applying for a waiver. That’s when Tim stepped in and did what no one else had done: he found the actual problem and fixed it. Not only that, his quoted price came in about 34% lower than a competitor’s quote for the same job. That alone got my attention, but what really stood out was his integrity. There’s a sign in his office about honesty in the small things reflecting honesty in the big ones, and I could tell he lives that. He explained everything in plain terms, no confusion, no runaround. He’s personable, professional, and clearly takes pride in doing the job right. Yes, I had to wait about a week for an appointment, but now I understand why. When someone does honest, quality work, people line up. Tim has earned my trust, and he’ll have my business going forward.

reviews.author: Alex Votary
reviews.text: Excellent shop! They diagnosed the issue quickly and got it taken care of. No up charging or funny business. Highly recommend. They stay busy, so you may want to call ahead for an appointment, but it's worth the wait.

reviews.author: Jason Oakes
reviews.text: Still my go to shop! .....Few years later, Tim is still my go to shop! They don't make to many shops like this anymore! Honest and reliable. Went for breaks and they checked them and said still had some life and just charged me to rotate the tires. Great owner! I will be back.

reviews.author: Cheryl Harden
reviews.text: This is the only place I will ever take my vehicles to They are honest and all around great. Tim is an absolute asset to his customers and to this town. Tim cannot thank you enough for all you do for us. Russ and Cheryl

reviews.author: Bryan Spears
reviews.text: I am new to the Gastonia area and as calling around i was fortunate to find this business. I was also extremely fortunate to make contact with Tim. He gave me a price quote over the phone and scheduled my appt same day, did repair same day at the exact price he had quoted. My Experience was very positive and this business offered a great experience. They will have my business AND will handle ALL of my auto needs going forward. What a blessing on a day that i really needed one. Excellent, excellent experience!! Thanks, Tim!!

reviews.author: Charity
reviews.text: We had driven here from out of state when our car started making noises that needed diagnosing. Tim was great, he figured out what the issue was and it turned out to be a cheaper fix than we'd expected. He ran through possible fixes and let us know what was really needed immediately and what we could wait on if we wanted. I felt he took the time to listen and didn't try to pressure us into anything. I really appreciated his time and work, they got us in quickly and all the work done the same day. If we lived in the area, this would definitely be our go-to mechanic.

reviews.author: Phillip Stacy
reviews.text: Tim does an excellent job and is priced fairly for the work being completed. I have been bringing vehicles to Tim personally for over 10 years and have never had a single issue. In addition, I have referred at least a dozen family members and friends to Tim and have heard nothing but positive reports back in terms of pricing, service and value. I personally drive 45 minutes from Rock Hill to bring my car to Tim as I have looked at several other options closer to home, but have never found another repair shop that is as honest as Tim and competently completes the work in a timely manner. An auto mechanic you can trust to do quality work while not ripping you off can be difficult to find, look no further as Tim's get you covered.

reviews.author: Shelena S
reviews.text: We live out of state and needed a mechanic for a car that would not start. After reading all the honest reviews here, we called and were impressed with the initial conversation with Tim. We chose to have the car towed there after hours. Tim handled it the next day and what we planned to have done, ended up not needing a new part. Tim just fixed the issue using the same part that just needed to be bolted in properly. We went ahead and asked him to change the breaks while it was there. He was honest, professional, affordable and kind. Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Candy Livingston
reviews.text: We have been taking out cars to Tim at Affordable Auto since he first opened the doors. He is the only mechanic we take out cars to for regular maintenance and repairs. He is fair, honest and he and his staff have always provided excellent customer service. The quality of there work is great and their prices are fair. I would highly recommend them!!!

reviews.author: William Goldman
reviews.text: Always great service here! Great mechanics! I bring both of my vehicles here (I live 26 miles away) for all service and repairs. They are efficient, trustworthy and dependable. I've been doing business with them for approximately ten years and I refer other people to them every chance I get. Give Tim a call-you'll be glad you did. Terry & Robin Goldman

reviews.author: tracy brooks
reviews.text: I have used Affordable Auto repair for years. Today I was reminded of whey that I use them. I had recently taken my wife's car into a local Dealership for her routine maintenance that is covered under her warranty. I was told she needed new brakes and the rotors turned. They gave me a price for the work to be done which I felt was a little high. I took the car to Tim at Affordable and after he looked at all 4 wheels he told me that the brakes were still good for about 15,000 miles and the rotors looked to be fine. He put the tires back on and told me he would see me in about 4 to 6 months. I have found that Tim and his staff at Affordable are the most honest people that I have ever dealt with in the car repair industry. If you haven't used them for your car repair then you should give them a try. I will only use them for all of my car repair work.

reviews.author: Maria Gomez
reviews.text: After driving from MA, I had a check engine light. I am happy to have found Affordable Auto. They diagnosed the issue and worked hard to both fix the problem and find the hard to get parts needed. Tim even looked at old engines for parts. Tim was very responsive via phone and email and kept me up to date on the progress. He also showed me the replaced parts and explained their function. I felt very well taken care of by affordable auto.

reviews.author: Chris Cope
reviews.text: Just an absolutely wonderful experience with Tim and his folks at Affordable Auto. I had a situation arise where my Volvo couldn’t be fixed at another location. He truly came to my rescue and got me back on the road. I would not pay any attention to a negative review as that is completely opposite of how these folks perform. Love Tim and his family! Blessings!

reviews.author: Glenn Ross
reviews.text: They are the only mechanic I trust whenever there is an issue with my car, or if I'm just needing routine service. I appreciate that Tim will run everything by me and inform me on whatever the issues are with my car before he does any work and will only work on what I request to have fixed. I've never once got a "snake" vibe from him like most mechanics give off. Overall it's a great place for any repairs or service you need, and in my opinion they are a very honest business.

reviews.author: Tee Gee
reviews.text: The only place that has and will ever touch my vehicle. Tim (I think is his name, that answers the phone) is very polite and respectful! They are very affordable and get the job done right. My SUV was taken in and was ready a day and a half later, here recently I had my SUV towed in on a Thursday around 2pm and it was ready by 10 the next morning. 1000% recommend!

reviews.author: Maurice McInnis
reviews.text: Always fair and honest. Tim really cares about doing what is right for the customer and I will recommend this repair shop to anyone. Just know he usually has a wait time. I had to wait 5 days for my last service, but I didn't mind because I wanted an honest opinion on what my car needed.

reviews.author: Denisha Wiggins
reviews.text: Needed a door handle latch replaced. I chose this place as the ratings of locals were high for this place. Ratings usually don't lie. Repairs took no longer than an hour by appointment and the cost was on the lower range compared to the dealership prices. I also purchased the part prior so this may have contributed to the low cost as well. Highly Recommend. Thanks Tim!

reviews.author: Shannon Kelly
reviews.text: The best auto shop in Gaston County. Tim is honest, polite, and knowledgeable. He has worked on my car many times. Look no further for your auto repair needs! If it’s something he doesn’t do at his shop, trust that he will know someone who can!

reviews.author: Amy Crisp
reviews.text: The first time I brought my car here, my air conditioning was on the fritz. I had gotten several estimates, all of which were in the $900 range. Tim fixed my a/c for about $500, and I have been bringing all my vehicles here ever since. Affordable Auto Repair lives up to its name and has friendly service, too!

reviews.author: Ashley Silva
reviews.text: Tim was AMAZING!! I went due to the 2 positive reviews I saw here. There should be more! The early opening hours didn't hurt either. I was passing through and my truck kept overheating due to the massive uhaul trailer I was towing. I called and Tim took me in as an emergency. I went to uhaul first to disconnect my trailer. I get there and their jack is broke! Called Tim and he said he'll take care of it. He fixed my car pretty quickly and kept me informed of anything he saw needed to be done before he did it. Tried to save me money. Being a female he didn't try to take advantage! My car runs wonderfully. If I lived here I wouldn't go anywhere else.

reviews.author: Emily Rose
reviews.text: I was stranded on Saturday night on the road with my van, which is where I live when I travel. My alternator went out. Monday morning Tim and the crew were able to get me back on the road before 2pm, they even checked my fluids for me without me asking (thankfully because I needed an oil change badly). They offered to change the oil, but left it up to me. I was talked to like a human, not like some dumb broad that knows nothing about cars, and I really appreciated that. Highly recommend taking your car here, even if your a single female stranded alone, this garage can be trusted to take care of you without taking advantage of you.

reviews.author: Patricia Whitworth
reviews.text: Tim and his crew are very honest mechanics, he doesn't take advantage of you just because you are a female, like some mechanics do. This my second car and it is a foreign car , he has always started at the least expensive point to see what works and found solutions that fixed and prevented potential problems. I would recommend him to any female who needs honesty.

reviews.author: Demetris Chambers
reviews.text: I've been doing business with Affordable Auto for over 10 years. Tim is very knowledgeable about all vehicle models and offers quick and accurate diagnosis to car issues. Great prices, friendly atmosphere, excellent customer service .

reviews.author: Brittny McKee
reviews.text: Took my car to Tim after dealing with issues and he was able to get it fixed up in just a few hours for an affordable price. Definitely will be going there from now on for all repairs.

reviews.author: Kayla S
reviews.text: I’ve taken my car there multiple time for all kinds of different things and they always do great work and reasonably priced. Tim answers any questions I have and I think that’s very important. I’ll always bring my cars here and my dad is going there too now.

reviews.author: mace pavelek
reviews.text: This guy is FANTASTIC!!! Since I work on my cars myself I was going to change a starter in my 2011 Acadia...no easy task. A friend suggested that I call. They only charged $110...and for that price they can have at it. I have had the actual dealership trace a check engine light issue and it kept coming back. They couldn't get it right iafter two visits. Tim fixed it while changing the starter and never even told me about it...no extra charge. In our modern world this is a paradise of honesty and fair prices. Thank you...thank you...THANK YOU!!!

reviews.author: Katie King
reviews.text: Tim (owner,operator) is one of the most honest,sincere people on the planet.My husband and his family have used Tim’s shop for various automotive maintenance through the years. I would highly recommend Tim and his staff for any of your mechanical needs

reviews.author: Harold Walker
reviews.text: Had my truck towed wouldn't crank. They checked it's old truck and gear shift wasn't all the way in park and it cranked. They made sure nothing wrong. Felt good to find a honest repair shop not trying over charge or fix something not wrong. They did my inspection and only charged for inspection. I be back because of true honesty and great service. Great customer service and call back.

reviews.author: Anna Grace King
reviews.text: Best place I’ve been to and will continue to come here for any of my car needs!!! Super efficient and gets the job done in a timely manner. Respectful owners that work with you on your time and like the name says, affordable!! Would 100% recommend these hard working guys!

reviews.author: Sue Sander
reviews.text: Tim is always helpful and honest. He will never allow me drive my car on long trips without first giving it a full inspection. He works around a busy mom’s schedule. He is honest, kind, and friendly.

reviews.author: Katina Moore
reviews.text: Tim is s real nice and professional business person as well a mechanic , his shop supplies every service imaginable at a fair price. Very trust worthy and no long waiting. I'm in for the long haul.

reviews.author: kaela thompson
reviews.text: Paid $1500 to fix a lot of issues on the car. Fuel pump repair, leaking of antifreeze, burning smell when running the heat and more. They fixed the leak “supposedly” but after I picked up the car the car was still in bad condition after I payed lot of money. I took the car back and asked them to look over it but they wanted to charge me again just to look over the car. The car still had issues with the air and the burning smell. Don’t go here if you’re a woman because they’ll take advantage of you and they think you’re plain stupid. Had problems with my car ever since! Also don’t claim to be Christian when you don’t treat people Christian like! Ripping them off for everything they got!

reviews.author: Carol Campbell
reviews.text: My son, who lives in Greensboro, needed a mechanic this week...oh how I wish he still lived in Gastonia so Tim and his guys at Affordable could have helped him out. Tim was always prompt, reasonable, but most of all honest when we needed a mechanic. These traits aren’t always easy to find these days. Give Affordable a try if you are in the Gastonia area. You be not be disappointed. Tell him that Ms. Carol sent you.

reviews.author: Shyrob Winters
reviews.text: I shopped around and had my vehicle looked at all around Gastonia. Tim was the only mechanic that I found to be honest and reasonably priced. He told me exactly what was wrong and told me what I needed and didn't need. Saved a bundle! And my vehicle runs like a champ! Definitely recommend this shop!

reviews.author: Robert Lyons
reviews.text: So far so good no problems to report we are having our vehicle work here definitely will report anything good or bad we have been looking for a good mechanic so hopefully these guys will take care of us! Update: All is well with this shop very helpful all needs are met, you couldn't ask for a better mechanic shop.!!!!!!! 4/16/23 Update: Still receiving wonderful service please if you are in need of there help do give them a try you won't regret it!

reviews.author: Jeannie Cox
reviews.text: If you are looking for an honest, good mechanic that stands behind their work, look no further than Affordable Auto. Tim and his staff are great at what they do. I highly recommend them for all your car repairs.

reviews.author: Dave
reviews.text: Traveling back and forth from Raleigh to Gastonia for work and noticed excessive heat build-up in the rear wheel. This was on a Friday morning and Tim was able to quickly get my car in, correctly diagnose the issue, and get the issue repaired (right driver's side caliper was sticking) for a reasonable price, all before noon! Thanks to this fast service I was able to drive back the same day..

reviews.author: Tonya Gonyea
reviews.text: Tim was great, very honest. Took my car in thinking it was the tentioner and serpentine belt needing to be replaced. But Tim realized it didn't need to be replaced just the belt and the pulleys. Very honest. SAVED me $200.

reviews.author: Valerie Schoen
reviews.text: The customer service at this mechanic is excellent. It is the only place I take my car for service. I have never been disappointed. Tim keeps my car running like it just came off the assembly line!

reviews.author: brad beam
reviews.text: Have had all my vehicles here and the whole staff is friendly and knowledgeable. They do great work at a reasonable cost.

reviews.author: A Davis
reviews.text: I was searching for a place that could repair my car at a reasonable price. I scheduled my car to be dropped off to be diagnosed. I knew prior to the issue that that water pump & timing belt needed to be replaced. After repairing with equipment bought by me, my car ran totally CRAZY & HORRIBLE. Jumping and lurching, to the point where I had to put the car in neutral or park at a stop. I took it to Miller's and was told that the timing belt was not put back on properly therefore causing my car to dump raw fuel leading to both catalytic conv. failing. The repairs was well over $2200. I immediately returned to AAC and showed them the diagnostics from Miller's. After arguing Tim up & down, (he knew exactly what they did and was not taking responsibility for it) and explaining how the job was not properly done, he agreed to pay for HALF of the price for the timing belt being put back in timing, NOTHING for my catalytic converters that I could not afford and I did not cause to fail. His argument was that I drove the car while issues persist, as if I didn't know that he did not repair my vehicle correctly. Unfortunately I had to get rid of the car, I put over $3000 in less than 3 months. Service needs to be better and mechanics need to know what they're doing. I was told by a friend that everytime she took her car there issues persist and worsened due to people doing half a** jobs and not doing anything at all. Do better or continue losing business from valued customers.

reviews.author: Paula Brown
reviews.text: By far the best mechanics. They take good care of my car and do not overprice service. Fair and honest. I tell people to go here all the time. They will NOT take advantage of a female car owner.

reviews.author: dennis eason
reviews.text: Honest and knowledgeable. I have used Tim for many years. He has performed everything from oil changes to valve jobs for me. Wouldn’t use anyone else.

reviews.author: David cortes
reviews.text: Super rude guy at desk will not come back to this place it had racist vibes!!!!! I came to check out a price for an inspection and the guy at the desk talked to me with major attitude after I had to wait 10 minutes for him to get off the phone. Fire your guy at the desk and get someone with people skills. He Did NOT earn my business.

reviews.author: Debra Payne
reviews.text: Best auto repair I have ever taken my car to. Tim and his staff do excellent work. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Janette Sullivan
reviews.text: This is the best place ever! Tim fixed my car in a timely manner, and the price is always fair! I will continue taking my vehicles here.

reviews.author: J Richard Martinez
reviews.text: Affordable Auto Care is nothing short of outstanding! They are honest and very affordable! Honesty is huge for me! And they have earned my respect and admiration!

reviews.author: Jason Tomscha
reviews.text: These guys are great. Professional and great prices. I will not take my cars anywhere else. Replaced my A/C for $1000 less than other places quoted.

reviews.author: Kparkulo
reviews.text: Tim has been amazing working with cars in my family. I would highly recommend this shop to anyone looking for honest, affordable, and dependable auto repair!

reviews.author: Brittany Way
reviews.text: GO SOMEWHERE ELSE!!! There is a guy here named TIM who has a bad attitude, he is short tempered and can’t handle the elements of his job being rude to people is not how you do business, oh and try calling up here they don’t answer phones I called up here for an hour and a half and no answer so I drive up here and he is sitting behind a desk right where the phone is at this place is garbage. I suggest somewhere else.

reviews.author: James Chambers
reviews.text: my car was undiagnosed by 1 garage and misdiagnosed by another with an estimate of about $400. Tim and Chuck found a bad ground and repaired it for $60. very satisfied!

reviews.author: Brenda Kay
reviews.text: Tim French is the best Mechanic I know. If the car is fixable he can fix it at fair and honest price. Try him you will not be sorry.

reviews.author: Tracy McAferty
reviews.text: Couldn’t get anyone to answer the phone so I drove to them and very disappointed that they were booked until next Tuesday! Two men sitting behind the counter didn’t offer any other option when asked. I guess they have enough business to not be concerned with any “new” business. I do not recommend them and will not be back! Thankful for Santiago though!

reviews.author: Leah Tate
reviews.text: A+ service! Honest, professional and caring staff. Tim is great. We won’t take our vehicles anywhere else!

reviews.author: kayla locke
reviews.text: They're always honest, give me. The the best service. I don't even live in Gastonia anymore but I still take my cars there.

reviews.author: Melodys music
reviews.text: 3rd time Ive had work done. Cant say enough about this business Always treat u with respect Very knowledgeable n yes! affordable is very accurate.

reviews.author: Valerie Jordan
reviews.text: This place is amazing!! Tim is honest and does really great work. The prices are really great. Honestly, this is the only place I trust. I feel lucky I found them. Thanks!!

reviews.author: Daniel Mitchem
reviews.text: I went there for air conditioning and he took me right in while also working on other vehicles. Checked for leaks and replaced valve. My new favorite auto repair place.

reviews.author: Frederick Haibach
reviews.text: Friendly and efficient. They are always busy in a good way. They got me in on Friday and called me at 3pm the same day to tell me that the work was done.

reviews.author: Marianne C.
reviews.text: Knowledgeable and trustworthy, Tim does excellent work at a reasonable price. Hands down- the best mechanic in town!

reviews.author: Cassie “xTrA” Medlin
reviews.text: Great mechanics and totally unbelievable low prices. Will continue using them and still do. Also met a celebrity while I was there!

reviews.author: Allen Chambers
reviews.text: I have been going here for years and won't consider anywhere eles. Tim and his crew are honest and do great work.

reviews.author: Jessica McGinnis
reviews.text: Tim at Affordable Auto Repair always takes care of my fiancé and my car needs and is a honest business owner.

reviews.author: Randy Walker
reviews.text: Great service, great price, great speed. Definitely recommend. They were fast, to the point, very punctual and they did a good job.

reviews.author: Jill Fields
reviews.text: Great mechanics. They get the job done and are honest folks. You can't go wrong with Affordable Auto Repair.

reviews.author: Amy Harris
reviews.text: Tim and his crew always take great care of my van. I appreciate having a place I can trust and afford.

reviews.author: Irma Muhammad
reviews.text: I was in and out. Great service at an affordable price. Seating area was comfortable. I wish I had known about this business sooner.

reviews.author: Leona Hill
reviews.text: I like this place. They have car towing, call you back and give info on your car. Friendly and reliable

reviews.author: Stormy Gallant
reviews.text: Went in, asked for a used tire because mine kept going flat, guy took my tire off, took it back, put air in it, brought it back out, claiming it was a new to me used tire, and charged me $25.

reviews.author: Kyshia Davis
reviews.text: Nice, polite, very detailed regarding repairs, and affordable. I'll definitely continue business with Affordable Auto.

reviews.author: Jenee Farmer
reviews.text: They work hard to determine the issue. Running all codes and such. Appreciate their efforts to assist and be efficient

reviews.author: Garrett Jones
reviews.text: Best shop in town hands down. Owner is extremely knowledgeable and one of the most friendly guys I know!

reviews.author: Lisa Christiansen
reviews.text: I was told by meineke that I needed tie rods and control arm. All I needed was a front end alignment. Saved me a fortune
